Relatives visiting Israel
Hi everyone! 🤍

I had my second A5 interview today and took the opportunity to ask about the process for inviting a relative to visit Israel (for up to 90 days) and helping ensure a smooth entry into the country.

They gave me a list of documents that both the visitor and I (along with my husband) need to submit. Once everything is prepared, the next step is to schedule an appointment to present these documents and pay the required fee. That’s it! 

I hope this helps!
